log.notes_to_self: Plan: learn which source kinds L cannot trace while avoiding 1,000-suspect cutoff. Initially kill national + forum + foreign only (5/day), all afternoon. Afternoon kills exclude day workers but preserve students/night workers/home, leaving 55,000 before source evidence. Forum and foreign constraints alone leave at least 3,437 suspects, safely above cutoff. Do not introduce other source kinds blindly: three independent 25% constraints with routine restriction can leave only 859 and end game. Repeat this restricted set through first press conference after day 3; use pool feedback to infer whether forum/foreign are accessible. Both accessible tends toward 3,437 (rounded 3,000), one toward 13,750 (10,000), neither 55,000 (60,000); hidden secondary reporting can soften deductions, so feedback may be higher. Need eventually identify inaccessible kinds to expand toward 8+ kills/day and rolling multipliers. National always safe. Major/minor has no stated scoring or trace difference. All quick kills afternoon preserves maximum routine ambiguity at this volume.

Day 2 continued national+forum+foreign only, 5 quick afternoon kills; cumulative 10 points expected. Maintain this set through day 3 press conference. Afternoon excludes day workers but retains night workers, students, home: 55% population. Forum and foreign constraints alone leave at least 3,437 suspects, safely above 1,000. Hidden secondary reports only weaken these constraints. Avoid introducing regional/sector/age blindly: adding a third 25% constraint could reduce pool to 859 and trigger capture. L cannot access exactly two of five source kinds; need infer these to expand kills and earn rolling bonuses (30/5 days doubles, 40 quadruples). After day 3, pool near 3,000 suggests both forum and foreign accessible; near 10,000 suggests one accessible; near 60,000 suggests neither, but incomplete traces can leave higher pools. National always safe. Keep all quick kills afternoon to preserve maximum routine ambiguity. Major/minor has no stated mechanical effect.

Day 3: killed national + both forum + both foreign, all quick afternoon. Expected cumulative 15 points. Continue these 5 daily until assessing day-3 press conference. Afternoon deaths retain night workers, students, home (55%); avoid morning because it excludes students when >2 deaths occur then. Forum+foreign constraints alone retain at least 100000*.55*.25*.25=3437.5 suspects, safely above 1000. Hidden extra reports only weaken those source constraints. A third accessible 25% source constraint could lower pool to 859, causing capture. Exactly two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible to L; any trace involving an inaccessible kind fails entirely. Day-3 pool near 3000 suggests both forum and foreign accessible; near 10000 could mean one accessible; near 60000 could mean neither, but incomplete successful traces and disjunctive secondary reports make higher pools ambiguous. Do not assume a kind is inaccessible just because pool has not yet fallen. Need identify safely expandable sources for rolling bonus: 30 deaths over last 5 days doubles today's kills, 40 quadruples. Current pace 25/5 days gives no bonus. National always safe. Major/minor has no stated effect. Preserve these notes and update using new conference.

Day 4: killed national d4-3, forum d4-5/d4-10, foreign d4-1/d4-8, all quick afternoon. Cumulative 20 points. Day-3 conference: 10000 suspects. This suggests one of forum/foreign inaccessible, but is not proof: incomplete traces and secondary-report disjunctions can leave both-accessible pools above their eventual floor. Continue these five daily through day-6 feedback before considering expansion. This strategy guarantees at least 100000*.55*.25*.25=3437.5 suspects: afternoon retains night workers, students and home (55%); every successful nonnational trace is satisfied by forum or foreign membership. Never add morning deaths: >2 would eliminate students. A third accessible region/age constraint could reduce the floor to 859; sector to 687.5, risking capture. Exactly two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible; a trace involving either inaccessible kind fails entirely. Secondary reports weaken constraints or block tracing. National is always safe; major/minor has no stated effect. Current five-per-day pace gives 25 deaths per five days, below the 30 threshold for double and 40 for quadruple. Rounded conferences alone cannot prove a source inaccessible after a few days. Next conference after day 6. Preserve safe options rather than gambling on day-3 pool.

Continue these five daily pending feedback. Keeping all deaths in afternoon preserves night workers, students and home (55%). Restricting sources to national/forum/foreign guarantees a suspect floor of 100000*.55*.25*.25=3437.5, even if both forum and foreign are accessible: anyone following both satisfies every successful source trace. Exactly two of regional/sector/age/forum/foreign are inaccessible; any trace involving an inaccessible kind fails entirely. Secondary reports can weaken constraints or block tracing. The 10000 conference suggests one of forum/foreign inaccessible but does not prove it because sampling and secondary reports delay narrowing. Adding regional or age could reduce the guaranteed floor to 859; adding sector to 687.5, risking capture. Avoid morning deaths, especially >2 per day, which eliminate students. Five daily deaths yields only 25 per rolling five days, below multiplier thresholds of 30 and 40. National always safe; major/minor has no stated effect. Do not infer inaccessibility with certainty from rounded conferences.

Continue these five daily until feedback supports a safer expansion. All-afternoon deaths preserve night workers, students, and home routines (55%). Avoid morning deaths, especially more than two per day, since losing students reduces the suspect floor.
